newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian tourists in Kenya warned to stay inside.
newsitem.headline: Belgian tourists in Kenya warned to stay inside.

text.p: The Belgian foreign ministry on Monday warned Belgian tourists on holiday in Kenya to stay in their hotels and anyone intending to go there to take extra care.
The ministry said Belgian tourists had not been affected by the rioting in the port city of Mombasa.

"Since the unrest in Kenya as a whole is continuing -- rioting in Nairobi in July and now in Mombasa -- the ministry advises travellers leaving for Kenya to observe the necessary caution," a spokesman said.
At the slightest sign of trouble Belgians should report to the embassy in Nairobi or the consulate in Mombasa.
He said between 350 and 360 Belgians currently lived in Kenya, the majority of them in Nairobi. Thirty or 40 were in Mombasa, while some 200 tourists were visiting Mombasa.
At least 33 people have been killed in the last five days in Kenya amid an outbreak of violence and thuggery.
